sections.text: Good Grief, What a Glutton You Are

-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 30 Cost.
Cost removal effect boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Slumber for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all allies. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
-Applies Guilty Eclipse (nullifies newly applied buff effects, blocks max HP increase effects, reduces action speed by 30, and reduces HP recovery effects by 100% (Heal Resistance)) to the enemy Field for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 30000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
